name: MemberPicture
description:
Piqueray member picture. A circular member-photo component with two states, extracted from the Figma COMPONENT_SET « MemberPicture » on DS · Atomes, reviewed and adopted — not authored.

The etat variant stacks two 364×364 circular image planes: normal is opaque in defaut and transparent in survol, with a 300ms opacity transition. The root clips both planes at its 500px radius. The visible normal plane receives its code-only src and alt scalars from its composed parent.

† A5 technical placeholder: the source IMAGE pixels of funIa are unavailable to the contract→canvas transport. That hidden-under-normal layer therefore keeps the engine's generic #D9D9D9 image-placeholder wash. This is not a Piqueray colour extracted from Figma, and the survol-only funIa plane remains outside the runtime photo API.

props.name: etat
props.description: Visual state: default (no overlay) or hover (overlay visible). Extracted from the VARIANT property « Etat » on the Figma master.

props.name: taille
props.description: Compatibility axis retained for existing consumers. Both values now use the same parent-owned fluid square geometry; the old 363.5px workaround belonged to the former fixed-track approximation.

props.name: src
props.description: La ROUTE du portrait, jamais ses octets. Figma n'expose aucune propriete de composant pour ces pixels (trou A5, matrice ligne 91, colonne Bindable : image content not bindable) : le contrat porte la route, la photo arrive a l'execution. Defaut vide, et il le reste. Le root de ce composant porte deliberement un lavis technique #D9D9D9 comme base de previsualisation A5 : c'est un fait de CONTRAT, pas une frontiere image. La photo qu'un designer voit sur le canevas est une maquette, hors contrat, preservee a la regeneration par une passe de sauvetage explicite (docs/handoff/08-status-what-doesnt-work.md, §6).

root.description: Square circular clipping root. The Figma master is presented at 364×364, while composed instances fill their parent width and retain a native 1:1 aspect ratio. Its #D9D9D9 fill is only the generic technical A5 preview base, never a Piqueray colour.

funIa.description: Underlying member photo plane. † A5: source IMAGE pixels are unavailable; the engine renders its generic technical placeholder, not a Piqueray colour.

normal.description: Top member photo plane. It is opacity 1 in defaut and opacity 0 in survol; its code-only src and alt scalars render the MemberCard instance's normal IMAGE override.
